displayName: CareDroid Unified AI Node (NLU + artifact router)
purpose: Local embedding (Xenova all-mpnet-base-v2) + MLP heads for clinical intent routing and artifact-type routing (ADR-0003).
prohibitedUses: Treating NLU accuracy metrics on tiny test sets as external validity
trainingDataLineage: Local JSONL corpora under backend/ml-services/{nlu,artifact-router}/data; leak-free hard-example mining scripts. Frozen sentence embeddings; small classifier heads only.

nlu.caveat: Small set; remeasure with larger held-out — not external validity

artifactRouter.note: Held-out test accuracy after surface shape cues + single-pass train (hard-example second pass disabled — it regressed test score).

limitations: NLU metrics.json may be missing on some worktrees until pipeline re-run.
Routing only — downstream tools/calculators remain authoritative for scores.

deployment.rollback: Disable NLU_SERVICE_ENABLED or fall back to pattern/keyword routing; restore previous classifier.json from models/.

history.note: NLU + artifact-router combined behind one manifest.
Artifact-router test accuracy 94.19% → 96.45% (n=310). Single unified models/ tree only; hard-example pass opt-in.

retirementPlan: Retrain heads with larger held-out eval; promote via registry + offline gate; keep prior classifier artifacts for rollback.
